actions: On a physical phone, verify loaded and failed-font threshold readability, spacing, no horizontal overflow, and native reachability of every line and enter at enlarged text sizes and short viewport heights.
With VoiceOver on macOS and iOS, navigate from initial load before visual arrival and confirm all three text groups and the native enter button occur in the intended reading order.
Verify browser-native 200% text zoom and keyboard focus on the threshold, confirming enter appears immediately on focus with its 2px outline and 3px offset.
Check the threshold in Safari and Firefox for natural reveal playback, focus and blur stability, reduced-motion changes, and native keyboard scrolling, and record any engine-specific failures.
